decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on 23rd November 2006, the erection of a rear roof extension incorporating 3 front roof lights to the existing house, which has the volume of 26.68m3 and would give a total volume increase to the original house of 48.62m3, as shown on drawing number 6119, received 23rd November 2006, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
Following the proposed erection of a rear roof extension incorporating 3 front roof lights to the existing house, the resulting building would fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Classes B and C of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
Condition : 2 - Informatives: 
1		The proposed roof extension must not be higher than any part of the existing ridge of the roof. The original ridgeline and ridge capping of the house should be maintained.

Condition : 3 - 2		The roof lights hereby permitted shall be flush with the existing plane of the roof.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a rear roof extension incorporating 3 front rooflights to the existing house
